## Notes

Baseline for the `read-through-gateway-caches` change. Measured at the same operating point as the 2026-09-28 reference
(127 vs 124 workload units/s, `CALIBRATE_MAX_RATE=200`) so the per-request comparison is apples-to-apples, with 0 failed
requests. The list read improved markedly (`FetchShowcases` mean 8→3 ms, p95 11→6, p99 24→14); the by-ID read and the
writes are ~flat. Two write-lifecycle p99 tails exceeded the 50% tolerance and were accepted into the reference:
`PollShowcase.p99` 24→56 ms (the any-event eviction now forces the by-ID poll to re-query rather than serve a cached
value — the intended freshness/load trade) and `StartShowcase.p99` 18→45 ms (a command the cache cannot affect, read as
tail noise within the aggregate p99 range of the prior runs — 14 and 22 ms on 2026-09-27 and 2026-09-28). The aggregate
p99 (20 ms) sits between those two runs.
